text:
marie: Anyone owning Valencia region provisioning? Need quick routing + residency check before we sign the colo PO with Equinix. Who's picking up routing/peering and egress policy?

sam: I can take routing and VPC peering. Will set up BGP session stub. Need KMS owner for key policy/grants.

andre: I'll own KMS/key policy. Note: our key rotation window is 02:00-03:00 UTC and new grants need explicit conditions.

lia: I'm tracking data residency for embeddings. Question: are we storing vectors in s3-eu-valencia or replicating to central eu-s3? Compliance may require vectors to stay in-valencia. Need a residency tag pattern: `residency=valencia`.

kevin: On egress/legal: default should be deny outbound to internet. We'll maintain an allowlist of CIDRs/services. Draft example policy below (to be refined):
```json
{
  "egress": "deny",
  "allowlist": ["10.0.0.0/8", "13.224.0.0/12", "52.95.0.0/16"]
}
```

oncall-bot: smoke-test: valencia-provisioning branch -> deploy smoke ✓ all probes ok (latency 28ms) :white_check_mark:

sam: pinging @eng-sre for BGP review and e2e tests. PR 4521 updates `route-policy` terraform; can reviewers pls triage? ETA EOD.

andre: I'll open a PR for the KMS policy and a short ACL for grants. checklist I'm tracking: `VPC peering`, `route tables`, `BGP session`, `egress filter`, `KMS grant`, `residency tags`, `backup replication config`.

marie: :thumbsup: please add owners into the Valencia Confluence doc and link PRs. Short runbook for cutover would be great — keep it < 10 steps.

lia: One more compliance Q: do we need to disable cross-region backups for embeddings? Legal suggested avoiding replication outside Spain for certain customers. If yes, we need a per-tenant backup flag.

kevin: I'll draft the egress allowlist and post to infra-confluence, and add a firewall preflight checklist. Will include steps to test egress deny + allow exceptions.

sam: owners so far: sam (routing/peering), andre (kms/key policy), kevin (egress), lia (data residency/embeddings). I'll update PR description with owners and test plan.

marie: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a brief async handoff doc and schedule a 30m sync tomorrow for any blockers. If anything urgent ping me directly.
